A 32-second instrumental cue for the opening of a stop-motion film about a crew of clay mice who make films in a lighthouse at night. [0:00-0:05] Near silence: three soft music-box notes in the dark over a hush like the sea. [0:05-0:13] Celesta and pizzicato strings begin a tender, curious melody in D major at 90 bpm. [0:13-0:21] Warm clarinet and bassoon join with brushed snare and upright bass; the tune turns playful and hopeful. [0:21-0:27] A magical swell: strings, glockenspiel and a harp glissando, bright and full of wonder. [0:27-0:32] It settles into a cosy held chord. Acoustic, handmade, whimsical, gentle. No vocals.
